findings.claim: Rolling Slam clears; Blood Hunt bursts.
findings.issue: Rotation names Rolling Slam as the clear skill, but Blood Hunt's group is the clear group's main damage source (D-122)
findings.evidence: the fix round left the Rotation line unchanged
findings.reader: The Rotation section is wrong to call Rolling Slam your clear skill: Blood Hunt does the clearing damage, so lead packs with Blood Hunt.
